name: Dual, X, resonators, valved mufflers
notes: Two sides, an X after the main pipes, a quarter-wave stub at 200 Hz on each side (a crossplane V8's firing order at 3000 rpm), chambered mufflers with a bypass valve each that opens above 3500 rpm and half load. The card's typical dual system (its cost: docs/models/exhaust.md). A part build: only spec.exhaust; every other field keeps its default.
